description: A sealed pack artifact carries its reserved signature.json envelope: the content_digest matches the canonical digest over the artifact's extracted entry set (manifest.json, page documents, locale catalog — everything but the envelope entry itself), the ed25519 signature verifies over the domain-separated statement binding artifact_id/kind/subtype/version/content_digest under a key the trust-anchor set authorizes for the acme namespace, and the bundled manifest's id/version equal the signed artifact_id/version — so the install pipeline accepts it and only then proceeds to the manifest gate.

expected.digest_scope: every extracted entry except signature.json itself
expected.identity_binding: manifest id/version MUST equal the signed artifact_id/version
